appDescription: Chajak turns a melody the driver hums, or a conversation recorded in the car, into a finished song with lyrics and cover art, and lets the driver change the arrangement and play songs by voice.

function.name: START_HUM_RECORDING
function.description: Starts recording the user's humming after a short 3-2-1 sound countdown, so the melody can be turned into a song.

function.name: FINISH_HUM_RECORDING
function.description: Ends the humming recording that is in progress, either keeping it to convert into a melody or discarding it.

result.description: save keeps the recording and converts it into a melody; cancel discards the recording.

function.name: CHANGE_SONG_ARRANGEMENT
function.description: Makes a new version of the song currently open in Chajak with a different arrangement, keeping the user's melody, lyrics and cover.

request.description: The change the user wants to the arrangement, kept in the user's own words and language.

function.name: START_CONVERSATION_RECORDING
function.description: Opens the conversation recording screen so the people in the car can record their talk (up to thirty minutes) and turn it into song lyrics. Recording starts after the user confirms on screen that everyone was told.

function.name: FINISH_CONVERSATION_RECORDING
function.description: Ends the conversation recording that is in progress, either keeping it to write down and turn into a song story or discarding it.

result.description: save keeps the recording; cancel discards it.

function.name: PLAY_LATEST_SONG
function.description: Plays the most recently finished song in Chajak.

function.name: STOP_SONG
function.description: Stops the Chajak song that is playing.
